notes: EBIT is defined as 'Income from railway operations' (operating income proxy) from NSC consolidated statements of income. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))

D&A uses the face-line item 'Depreciation' from the income statement; NSC does not present a separate amortization line on the consolidated statement of income. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))
Capex is modeled from cash flow 'Property additions' (absolute value of cash outflows). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))

NWC is defined as Total current assets minus Total current liabilities using GAAP line items from the balance sheet (this includes cash and excludes the common 'cash/debt-excluded' refinement). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))

Tax rate is set to NSC’s effective tax rate for 2025 (income taxes / income before income taxes) as shown in the tax rate reconciliation. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))

WACC and terminal growth/multiple are not explicitly provided by NSC; they are modeling assumptions. (This package sets WACC=0.085, terminal growth=0.02, terminal exit EV/EBITDA=14.2 derived from a peer average of class-I rail EV/EBITDA multiples.) ([alphaspread.com](https://www.alphaspread.com/security/nasdaq/csx/relative-valuation/ratio/enterprise-value-to-ebitda))

NOL balance was not located as a discrete numeric balance in the accessible 10-K text extraction; nol_balance is set to null. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))
Current price uses a market-data snapshot with latest trade time on Mar 20, 2026; package as_of_date is Mar 21, 2026.

Comps multiples are taken from AlphaSpread: EV/S is treated as a proxy for EV/NTM revenue and EV/EBITDA is treated as an EV/NTM EBITDA proxy due to data availability limits in the peer tables. ([alphaspread.com](https://www.alphaspread.com/security/nasdaq/csx/relative-valuation/ratio/enterprise-value-to-sales))

catalysts: Regulatory milestones for the Union Pacific transaction (including STB-related requirements), which can change probability-weighted outcomes. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))

Sustained execution on productivity and operating ratio improvements, supported by the cost/safety initiatives highlighted in 2025 results. ([norfolksouthern.com](https://www.norfolksouthern.com/en/newsroom/news-releases/norfolk-southern-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results))

Ongoing resolution and uncertainty reduction related to the Eastern Ohio incident and related proceedings. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))
company_overview: Norfolk Southern is primarily engaged in U.S. rail transportation of raw materials, intermediate products, and finished goods. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))

As of Dec 31, 2025, NSC operated approximately 19,100 route miles in 22 states and the District of Columbia. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))
NSC is managed as one reportable operating segment: railway operations. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))
current_context: Full-year 2025: revenue (railway operating revenues) of $12.18B (essentially flat vs. 2024) and income from railway operations of $4.36B; operating ratio improved to 64.2%. ([norfolksouthern.com](https://www.norfolksouthern.com/en/newsroom/news-releases/norfolk-southern-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results))

Company highlighted productivity/cost actions, including over $215M in annual savings, while emphasizing safety/service improvements into 2026 despite an unclear demand environment. ([norfolksouthern.com](https://www.norfolksouthern.com/en/newsroom/news-releases/norfolk-southern-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results))

Merger context: NSC’s proposed combination with Union Pacific remains subject to U.S. Surface Transportation Board approval, with a $2.5B termination fee referenced in the 10-K. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))
investment_highlights: Base-case modeling assumes modest post-2025 growth (mid-single-digit? no—low single-digit) after near-flat 2023–2025 revenue performance. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))

EBIT margin in the base case is normalized around the mid-to-high 30% range, reflecting 2024–2025 operating performance while muting incident/one-time effects. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))

Capital intensity is modeled with capex at ~18.5%–19% of sales and depreciation at ~11%–11.5% of sales, consistent with the recent historical ratios. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))

Working-capital needs are incorporated via an NWC utilization rate (NWC as total current assets minus total current liabilities) that is modeled as negative based on recent year-end balance sheets. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))

Terminal value is anchored to a long-run exit EV/EBITDA multiple consistent with observed peer railroad valuation levels. ([alphaspread.com](https://www.alphaspread.com/security/nasdaq/csx/relative-valuation/ratio/enterprise-value-to-ebitda))
key_risks: Transaction risk: delays, adverse regulatory conditions, or failure to close can increase costs and impair management focus. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))

Rail cyclicality: volume and pricing can swing with macro conditions; fuel surcharge dynamics add volatility. ([norfolksouthern.com](https://www.norfolksouthern.com/en/newsroom/news-releases/norfolk-southern-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results))
Safety/regulatory risk, including potential incremental costs from major incidents on the network. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))

presentation.subtitle: DCF Inputs & Valuation Package — Norfolk Southern (NSC)
valuation_summary: DCF uses a consistent operating bridge: revenue growth + modeled EBIT margin to derive steady-state operating profitability over 2026–2030. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))

Terminal value is estimated with an exit-multiple approach using EV/EBITDA peer context, with terminal growth set conservatively. ([alphaspread.com](https://www.alphaspread.com/security/nasdaq/csx/relative-valuation/ratio/enterprise-value-to-ebitda))

Net asset assumptions use year-end cash, total debt, and equity-linked investments disclosed on the latest balance sheet. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/702165/000162828026006268/nsc-20251231.htm))
